text: The alarm rang and I took this dose straight away, at the planned time.
आज की दवा समय पर नहीं ले पाया, पर दो घंटे बाद ले ली।
Maybe goli li thi, pakka yaad nahi aa raha.
I have the tablet beside me, but have not swallowed it. I plan to do that later.
मेरी माँ ने दवा ली है। अपनी गोली के बारे में मुझे नहीं पता।
I skipped today's dose on the explicit instruction my clinician gave me yesterday.
Kal wali dose miss ho gayi thi, li hi nahi.
The morning pill was taken on schedule; the night pill was never taken.
